# Juan Alejandro Urueña Serna

> Personal site of Juan Alejandro Urueña Serna, Systems and Telecommunications Engineer and full-stack developer based in Pereira, Colombia. He builds complete web systems for clients in the United States and Colombia: websites, funnels with lead capture and analytics, and AI automation. He develops with AI agents under a written engineering cycle: define, plan, build, verify, ship.

Key facts:

- Ten projects in production across two countries; each one is linked from the site with its role stated honestly (client work, own product, demo, or participation).
- Stack: Next.js, React, Astro, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare, n8n, and LLM APIs.
- Degree project: deep learning applied to predictive maintenance of industrial machinery (TensorFlow/Keras, FastAPI, MQTT ingestion).
- Contact: alejourus2003@gmail.com
